description: Search NHTSA Standing General Order crash-report rows in the MORVS Self-Driving Crash Register. Requires ADS or Level 2 ADAS and can filter by company, state, alleged injury severity, crash month and the year NHTSA first received the report. Returns latest report versions with NHTSA CSV citations, not narrative text. No report has its own NHTSA web page. OTHER filings are never returned as crashes. Reports are each company’s own filings with NHTSA, not a finding, and say nothing about responsibility. The highest injury severity alleged says nothing about responsibility. ADS and Level 2 ADAS have different reporting requirements, are kept separate and are never added together; OTHER is never a crash count. Reports and crashes are different counts. Counts reflect fleet size and reporting rules; they are not rates, are never normalised by miles or fleet size, and are never a safety ranking. The third amended order changed reporting from June 16, 2025, so counts across that break are not directly comparable. A narrative marked as confidential business information is a claim, not an NHTSA decision. No people or narrative text are returned. NHTSA’s caveats are included verbatim.

company.description: Optional case-insensitive company name or slug substring.

crash_month.description: Optional crash month in YYYY-MM format.

kind.description: Required report kind: ADS or ADAS. These kinds are never added together.

limit.description: Maximum crash report rows returned, allowed 1-100.

severity.description: Optional published severity code. It describes the highest injury severity alleged, not responsibility.

year_received.description: Year NHTSA received the report, 2021-2026; defaults to the latest published year.

name: self_driving_reports
title: Find Self-Driving Crash Reports
